messages:
alex: quick heads-up — new customer reported that invited users stay in 'Pending' and get a 403 when they try to open the project console. Happens only for Okta-provisioned users via SCIM.
maya: can you paste repro steps and the exact 403? any error id or logs from the console page?
alex: repro steps: 1) Okta create user, 2) add to group 'platform-admins', 3) SCIM sync -> user appears in org users list as 'Pending' in console invite flow. When they click project, they get 403 console page. No invite acceptance flow appears.
alex: console shows client-side message: "You don't have permission to view this project (403)". On server logs we see an auth lookup failing: `no_rolebinding_for_group: platform-admins`.
jess: do we have a mapping from Okta group names -> Redwood rolebindings? is SCIM normalizing group names on our side?
alex: looks like Okta is sending group names with a prefix `EXT-` (weird legacy) — Okta SCIM attribute is `members` and group.name = "EXT-platform-admins". Our SCIM ingestion pipeline normalizes by stripping non-alphanum chars but doesn't remove `EXT-` prefix, so the group key becomes `EXT-platform-admins` and doesn't match the rolebinding `platform-admins` created manually in console.
maya: can you show the SCIM payload and the rolebinding entries? small snippet is fine.
alex: SCIM group patch from Okta (redacted):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
  "displayName": "EXT-platform-admins",
  "members": [{"value": "00u1234", "display": "alice@example.com"}]
}
```
alex: Rolebinding list for org `acme-corp` shows `platform-admins -> role:org_admin` but no `EXT-platform-admins` binding.
jess: that explains it. When user is created they get the group claim `EXT-platform-admins` and our mapping code tries to find an exact match for the group binding. if none -> user has no roles -> 403.
infra-bot: deploy-log: scim-ingest v2.3.1 successful at 2026-03-15T14:02:11Z
maya: workaround for the customer: either 1) rename Okta group to match our rolebinding, 2) create a rolebinding for `EXT-platform-admins` in the console, or 3) push a one-time SCIM resync after normalizing the group name on our side.
jess: long-term fix: update SCIM ingestion to strip common prefixes like `EXT-`, `AD-`, and to do fuzzy-match against existing rolebinding keys. but need to be careful with collisions.
alex: tried manual workaround: created `EXT-platform-admins` rolebinding in UI — users move from Pending -> Active and can access project. confirming workaround works for acme.
maya: for support ticket reply: advise customer on the three options (rename group, create rolebinding, or let us run a safe resync). ask if they want us to run resync and include org id + sample affected user email.
alex: sending them message now. ETA from customer: ~2 hours for permission to run resync.
ops-bot: incident-note: support/escalation created #INC-2026-0442 for SCIM prefix normalization; assigned to eng-ml (jess) and eng-infra (maya).
jess: I'll pick this up — plan: add normalization rule and a feature-flagged migration job to map `EXT-*` to existing bindings for 1 week, then monitor errors. will raise PR with tests.
maya: thanks. also leaving note: check audit logs so we don't accidentally bind groups to wrong roles in orgs with both `EXT-team` and `team` groups. :eyes:
alex: thanks team — closing this thread after customer confirms resync permission. :thumbsup:
